description: HYBRID fork of exp475 (TinyMHLut soft argmax everywhere, 1.4962): ONLY qkv_lut is replaced by the exp493 SOFT MatmulMultiHeadLut(gate_mode=softmax) (dense gated-matmul, full autograd, magnitude-leakage). v_lut/out_proj/residual_lut stay TinyMHLut(soft argmax). OPTIMIZER SPLIT: qkv (dense grads) -> AdamW wd=0.1 (like exp493); v/out/residual (sparse argmax grads) -> LION (like exp475). Tests if the soft win is qkv-localizable: how much of exp493's 1.4806 (all-soft) is recovered by paying the dense-matmul cost on ONLY the smallest module (qkv tph=64). vs exp475 1.4962, exp493 1.4806.
